cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR123, you are holding at holding point A9 runway 36L, you are fully ready. Call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航123，你在跑道36左A9等待点等待，已经准备好。呼叫武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR123, holding point A9 runway 36L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航123，跑道36左A9等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Tower, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉塔台，原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Holding at present position, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, confirm the traffic in sight on short final?[Tell the controller yes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，你看到短五边上的波音737了么？【告诉管制员看到了。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR123
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，看到了，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, line up behind the B737 on short final.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，跟五边波音737后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Line up behind the traffic, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟737后进跑道，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，可以起飞，起飞后，联系离场120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, airborne 120.2, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地频率120.2.，法航123。

cards.audioText: You are passing 900m, contact Wuhan Departure, ask whether you can cancel the SID, and proceed direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在通过900米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消SID，直飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR123, passing 900m, confirm can cancel SID and direct to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航123，通过900米，证实可以取消SID，直飞LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, continue climb and maintain 2400m, turn right direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉离场，雷达已识别，继续上升保持2400米，右转直飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb and maintain 2400m, turn right direct to LKO. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上升保持2400米，右转直飞LKO，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，上升保持标压4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climbing and maintain 4500m on standard, 119.7, AFR123.

cards.audioText: Your maintain 4500m position is just over LKO time 23, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA is 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 你保持在4500米，过LKO时间23分，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做标准位置报告，并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR123, over LKO 23, maintaining 4500m, next DARPO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航123，LKO 23分，保持4500米，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday, descend and maintain 1800m on QNH1012, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，收到Mayday，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1800m, QNH1012, turn right heading 360. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, contact Approach 119.85.
Your altitude is 1800m, you have information S, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行高度是1800米，你收到通播S，联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR123, maintaining 1800m, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航123，保持1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Approach, information Tango valid, descend and maintain 900m, expect radar vectors ILS runway 36L.[Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉进近，通播T有效，下降保持900米，雷达引导盲降跑道36左。【复诵，由于性能限度，请求降落在跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, expect radar vectors ILS runway 36L, information Tango. Request runway 36R due performance, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，雷达引导盲降跑道36左，通播T。由于飞机性能，请求跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, approved runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，同意跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Landing runway 36R, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 着陆跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你刚收到消息，降落过程中，一名乘客中风。通知管制员并要求到达时提供救护车。
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR123, request ambulance after landing, one passenger has suffered stroke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航123，请求到达时提供救护车，一名乘客中风。

cards.audioText: AFR123, roger, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，收到，我们会通知机场医疗援救，现在左转航向330，下降保持600米，可以盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 330, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，下降保持600米，可以盲降进近跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告进近你已切入航道，跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR123, we have intercepted the localizer runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航123，已经切入航道36右。

cards.audioText: AFR123, contact Tower 124.35.
